### 1 — Scene
Roast chicken—sliced breast and a drumstick—with a bowl of mixed fresh fruit. A glass of water is alongside; I exclude it from the food weight.

### 2 — Vessels
- **Chicken plate:** approximately 23 cm diameter; area = 3.14 × 11.5² ≈ **415 cm²**.
- **Fruit bowl:** approximately 19 cm diameter; area = 3.14 × 9.5² ≈ **283 cm²**.

### 3 — Items
Chicken breast, chicken drumstick with skin, cantaloupe, grapes, strawberries, pineapple, and apparent watermelon. No separate sauce or dressing is visible.

### 4–7 — Area, volume, weight, and energy
The drumstick estimate represents edible meat and skin, not its bone. Heights are average food-layer thicknesses.

| Item | Vessel area covered | Area (cm²) | Height (cm) | Gross volume (ml) | Density (g/ml) | Weight (g) | kcal/100 g | Energy (kcal) |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Chicken breast | 33% of plate | 137 | 1.0 | 137 | 0.95 | 130 | 165 | 215 |
| Drumstick meat and skin | 23% of plate | 95 | 1.0 | 95 | 0.95 | 91 | 215 | 196 |
| Cantaloupe | 24% of bowl | 68 | 1.9 | 129 | 0.60 | 77 | 34 | 26 |
| Grapes | 16% of bowl | 45 | 1.9 | 86 | 0.60 | 52 | 69 | 36 |
| Strawberries | 13% of bowl | 37 | 1.9 | 70 | 0.60 | 42 | 32 | 13 |
| Pineapple | 9% of bowl | 25 | 1.9 | 48 | 0.60 | 29 | 50 | 15 |
| Watermelon | 6% of bowl | 17 | 1.9 | 32 | 0.60 | 19 | 30 | 6 |

**Coverage check:** chicken covers approximately **56%** of its plate; fruit covers approximately **68%** of the bowl’s full projected area, leaving the rim exposed.

### 8 — Sanity check
Approximately **221 g of edible chicken** and **219 g of fruit** looks plausible for the visible portions. Estimated total: **440 g and 507 kcal**, with uncertainty mainly from chicken thickness and the drumstick’s bone.
